audit.why: Early is genuinely Qiyana-favored (dash, burst, brush weaving); TF wins via map play post-6. Page already frames it this way; 55.29% WR reflects the map game, not the lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: winCon claimed 'Nothing here works through Audacity' — Audacity is a targeted dash, not a spell shield; nothing is negated by it. Also no cooldown numbers anywhere despite Audacity 11/10/9/8/7, W 7, R 120 being in the kit.
audit.why: Kit text: E 'Qiyana dashes to an enemy' cd 11/10/9/8/7; W dash cd 7; R cd 120, projectile (blockable), knockup+stun off terrain/elements.
audit.corrected: Audacity is her only gap-closer onto TF (11s at rank 1, 7 at max); gold card is point-and-click peel that her kit cannot dodge; her R shockwave stuns only off river/brush/wall elements — stand off terrain and it is just damage.
Added Audacity 11s rank 1 / 7s max, W 7s, R 120s.
